index.video.p1: See how CognaBright brings visual routines, functional communication, multilingual support, meaningful goals and connected family-professional support together around everyday life.
index.video.p12: The video loads from YouTube in privacy-enhanced mode only when you choose to play it.
index.video.p13: Every day brings routines, transitions and moments when clearer support can make a real difference.
index.video.p14: Many families already use visual supports through therapy and school. CognaBright brings them together, with personalised visual routines built from clear, familiar steps.
index.video.p15: Run routines one step at a time, and record how each step was completed.
index.video.p16: Communication is more than speech. Visual choices and simple sentence building support requests, needs, asking for help and everyday messages.
index.video.p17: Visual boards put practical choices and communication within easy reach, in the moment.
index.video.p18: Multilingual families deserve multilingual support. Read, and where available hear, cards in a supported everyday language.
index.video.p19: Connect routines to meaningful goals, while structured evidence helps show patterns in participation and support over time.
index.video.p110: Bring goals, routines and observations together, and keep families and professionals connected, with access remaining a deliberate choice around the person and family.
index.video.p111: Rewards recognise participation, effort and everyday achievements in ways that matter to the person.
index.video.p112: Pain and Care gives a visual way to show where something doesn't feel right.
index.video.p113: And familiar visuals can be printed for home, school and community.
index.video.p114: Visual, multilingual, practical and connected. One person, one support circle. CognaBright: visual support for everyday life.
index.routines.heading1: See the steps. Understand what comes next.
index.routines.p1: Create personalised visual routines for the activities that make up a day, built from clear, familiar steps.
index.routines.card1.title: Build the sequence.
index.routines.card1.description2: Choose familiar visual steps, put them in order and save the routine for the person you support.
index.routines.card2.title: Use it step by step.
index.routines.card2.description2: Work through the routine one step at a time and record how each step was completed and what support was used.
index.routines.p12: Visual routines can make activities easier to understand and support participation — at the person's own pace.
index.images.routine_builder_en_webp.alt: Routine Builder showing a routine as a numbered sequence of illustrated steps
index.communication.p1: Visual choices, communication boards and simple sentence building support everyday communication — in the way that works for the person.
index.communication.item15: Build a simple sentence, like “I want lunch”
index.communication.p12: CognaBright is another practical visual communication support. It works alongside the AAC, therapy and school supports a person already uses, and does not replace them.
index.images.sentence_builder_en_webp.al: Build a Sentence showing a card’s sentence split into word tiles, with a Play sentence button
index.multilingual.p1: See it. Read it. Hear it. Communicate it.
index.multilingual.p12: In the language that works for them.
index.multilingual.p13: Use cards and visual content in nine supported languages, and hear cards read aloud in the selected language where a voice is available on the device.
index.multilingual.p14: For multilingual families, communication can happen in the familiar languages used at home and in the community — at the person's own pace.
index.multilingual.p15: Multilingual support is for everyday communication, not language lessons.
index.images.multilingual_sentence_pt_BR: Build a Sentence in Brazilian Portuguese, with the card “Café da manhã, por favor” split into word tiles and a Tocar frase button to hear it
index.goals.heading1: Turn everyday needs into meaningful goals.
index.goals.p1: Describe what matters to the person, then break it into micro goals — practical, observable steps that connect to daily routines.
index.goals.p14: Structured evidence and analytics help show patterns in participation and support over time. Goals can be pinned to the Care-team Workspace so everyone supporting the person sees the same priorities.
index.images.goals_en_webp.alt: Goals screen showing an active goal broken into smaller micro goals, with the option to pin them to the Care-team Workspace
index.connected.p1: Professionals remain part of the person's support circle. CognaBright helps practical information connect with everyday life — at home, at school, in the community and in professional support.
index.connected.card3.title: Care-team Workspace
index.connected.card3.description: Brings the person's current plan, pinned goals, daily timeline, observations and handover notes together in one shared place for the people supporting them day to day.
index.connected.card4.title: Care-team Connect
index.connected.card4.description: Recommendations and conversations between families and the organisations and professionals working with them. The family reviews each recommendation and decides whether to accept it.
index.images.care_team_workspace_en_webp: Care-team Workspace showing a support snapshot with communication, interests and important support notes for one person
index.connected.p12: An organisation can access a child's information only after a parent or guardian reviews and accepts its access request. Families can see active and previous connections, and access can be revoked.
index.rewards.heading1: Notice the effort. Celebrate the moment.
index.rewards.p1: Make achievement visible. Stars, Token Cards and Prize memory recognise participation, effort and everyday achievements in ways that matter to the person.
index.rewards.p12: Rewards are built around the person's own preferences — a way to celebrate together, not a way to control behaviour.
index.images.rewards_en_webp.alt: Rewards screen showing stars available and the stars earned for everyday routines
index.painCare.heading1: When it's difficult to say where something hurts.
index.painCare.p1: Visual support can help communicate it. Pain & Care gives a visual way to show pain, discomfort or where something doesn't feel right — by choosing a part of the body and how it feels.
index.painCare.p12: Pain & Care helps a person communicate. It does not diagnose a condition, provide medical advice or replace healthcare professionals. For urgent or worsening health concerns, contact the appropriate medical or emergency service.
index.images.pain_and_care_en_webp.alt: Pain & Care showing a leg diagram with numbered body parts to choose from
index.printStudio.heading1: Support doesn't have to stay on a screen.
index.printStudio.p1: Create print-ready visual supports with the familiar CognaBright visuals the person already knows — for home, school and the community.
index.printStudio.p12: Digital support, carried into everyday environments.
index.images.print_studio_en_webp.alt: Print Studio showing illustrated cards selected for a printable First / Then board
index.audiences.p1: CognaBright is designed for children, adolescents and adults with disability, and for the families and professionals who support them.
index.audiences.card5.title: Everyday support at home
index.audiences.card5.description: Build visual routines, communication supports and goals around the person you support, and decide which organisations are connected.
index.audiences.card6.title: Part of the support circle
index.audiences.card6.description: Therapists, educators and support workers connect through their organisation's CognaBright workspace — with the family's consent — and share recommendations through Care-team Connect.
index.audiences.card7.title: Consistent, person-centred support
index.audiences.card7.description: Support circles, Routine Studio, People & teams, goals, evidence and analytics for disability, allied-health, education and community organisations.
index.evidence.heading1: We say clearly what CognaBright does and does not claim.
index.evidence.p1: CognaBright does not claim to be clinically proven, independently validated, or used by a specific number of families. We publish a clear evidence-status framework so you can see what is verified, what is still developing, and what has not been claimed.
index.cta.p1: Start with visual routines, functional communication and connected support today — on the web, on your phone, tablet or computer.
common.footer.tagline: Visual support for everyday life — personalised around the person and connected with the people who support them.

evidence.meta.title: Evidence status | CognaBright
evidence.hero.title: Know the status behind the statement.
evidence.hero.intro: CognaBright uses a public status framework and a claims registry to separate what is verified, what is still developing, what is planned for evaluation, and what is not claimed.
evidence.framework.status1.description: Traceable to working product, working code in the audited marketing repository, or explicit approved evidence. Verification is scoped to the statement shown.
evidence.framework.status2.description: A capability under active development. Completeness and future availability are not implied.
evidence.framework.status3.description: A question, study or pilot pathway being prepared. Approval, commencement, completion and findings are not implied.
evidence.framework.status4.description: A statement deliberately withheld because evidence is absent, insufficient, unapproved or outside the audited scope.
evidence.position.card1.title: Family plans and pricing
evidence.position.card1.description: Family plans for one, two or three children are live today, with pricing fetched directly from CognaBright's subscription provider.
evidence.position.card2.title: Contact and enquiry workflow
evidence.position.card2.description: This website implements validated, server-side enquiry handling with a honeypot, request-size limits, consent capture and server-only database credentials.
evidence.position.card3.title: Ongoing feature development
evidence.position.card3.description: CognaBright's core features are available now. Some capabilities remain under active development, and exact workflows may still change.
evidence.position.card4.title: Clinical and research claims
evidence.position.card4.description: CognaBright does not claim to be clinically proven, independently validated, evidence-based in a research sense, or used or endorsed by a specific number of families, and does not claim to improve clinical, educational or family outcomes.
evidence.position.card5.title: Institutional proof
evidence.position.card5.description: No customer counts, partner logos, case-study results, certifications, service levels, return-on-investment or time-saving claims are published.
evidence.publication.p1: Material public statements carry a claim identifier in page markup. Automated tests check that each identifier exists in the repository registry and is approved for publication at its stated status.
evidence.publication.p12: Future evidence is reviewed for scope, source quality, permission, recency and wording before a claim changes status. A product roadmap, mock-up or marketing plan is not treated as evidence that a capability exists.
evidence.publication.link1: Ask a question about evidence status →
evidence.footer.p1: Evidence status is part of the public information architecture, not a footnote.

about.hero.title: Visual support for everyday life.
about.hero.intro: CognaBright brings visual routines, functional communication, multilingual support, goals and care-team collaboration together — personalised around the person, and connected with the people who support them.
about.images.about_us_webp.alt: A collage of families and support workers using tablets together at home
about.company.p1: CognaBright is developed by CognaBright Pty Ltd (ABN 54 701 887 774), an Australian disability-support technology company based in Queensland.
about.company.p12: Official CognaBright information and services are provided through cognabright.com, the CognaBright app at app.cognabright.com, and our verified social channels on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.
about.audience.eyebrow1: How we think about this work
about.audience.heading1: Support, not a game or a lifestyle product.
about.audience.p1: CognaBright is built around real, everyday support — not around competition, celebration for its own sake, or the idea that support needs are a lifestyle to sell. We talk about independence, communication, routines, progress and collaboration, and we let families and professionals make their own choices about what's right for them.
about.audience.p12: We don't promise outcomes, and we don't romanticise or trivialise disability. We aim to make everyday support clearer, more consistent and more connected — for the people receiving support, and the people around them.

about.principles.card2.title: Proportion
about.principles.card2.description: We describe what CognaBright does today as available now, and we don't present plans as finished work.
about.principles.card3.title: Permission

privacy.meta.description: How CognaBright collects, uses and protects personal information for families, organisations and the public website.
privacy.meta.title: Privacy | CognaBright
privacy.hero.title: Your information stays in your control.
privacy.hero.intro: This notice explains what personal information CognaBright collects, how it is used, and the choices you have — for the CognaBright application (families and organisations) and for this public website.
privacy.notice.p1: This notice applies to the CognaBright application (used by families, support workers and organisations) and to this public marketing website. Where the two differ, we say so below.
privacy.notice.p12: When you create a CognaBright account, we collect information such as your name, email address and account role (for example, a parent or guardian, a support professional, or an organisation administrator).
privacy.notice.p13: If you set up support for a child or another person you support, we collect the information you choose to add for that person — such as a name or identifier, routines, goals and micro-goals, communication supports, prompts, evidence and progress notes, and pain or care information where you choose to record it. This information is entered by you, or by a professional you've given access to, not collected from the person directly.
privacy.notice.p14: If you use Care-team connect or the Care-team workspace, we process the information you choose to share with the people you invite, and the access and role settings you assign them.
privacy.notice.p15: If you represent an organisation, we collect information about your organisation, its staff accounts, and the people your organisation supports, as set up by your organisation's administrators.
privacy.notice.p16: When you submit the public contact form, we collect your name, email, institution or organisation, organisation type, role, country or region, enquiry type, area of interest, message, privacy consent and optional updates preference. Please do not include health information or information that identifies a child, client, patient, participant or student in that form.
privacy.notice.p17: We also process limited technical information needed to keep the service secure, such as request timing and network address information used for abuse prevention.
privacy.notice.p18: We use this information to provide and personalise CognaBright — including routines, communication supports, goals, progress and Care-team collaboration — to process family and organisation subscriptions, to respond to enquiries and support requests, and to keep the service secure and working reliably.
privacy.notice.heading14: Sharing follows your choices and permissions
privacy.notice.p19: Families decide how information is shared with the people involved in their child's support. Organisations manage access for their own staff according to the roles and permissions they assign. CognaBright uses secure systems, and information is only visible to the people a family or organisation has chosen to give access to.
privacy.notice.p110: We may share information with service providers who help us run CognaBright — such as our hosting, authentication and subscription-billing providers — under terms that limit their use of it to providing that service to us.
privacy.notice.p111: You sign in to CognaBright using an email address and password, or another supported sign-in method. We use this to verify it's you and to keep your account secure.
privacy.notice.p112: Family plan pricing and billing are handled by CognaBright's subscription provider. CognaBright does not store your full payment card details. Organisation pricing is arranged separately after an enquiry.
privacy.notice.p113: This public marketing website does not use advertising trackers, behavioural analytics, heat maps or a newsletter service. The contact form does not set a marketing cookie. Hosting and security providers may still process ordinary request logs as part of delivering the website.
privacy.notice.p114: The CognaBright application uses functional cookies or local storage needed to keep you signed in and remember your preferences, and may use limited tools to help keep the service reliable and secure. CognaBright does not sell personal information.
privacy.notice.p115: We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to provide CognaBright, meet legal and regulatory obligations, resolve disputes, and maintain appropriate business records.
privacy.notice.p116: We use server-side credentials and access controls so that account and support information is not available for anonymous public reading, and information is transmitted using encrypted connections. No system can be guaranteed completely secure, and we work to keep our practices up to date.
privacy.notice.p117: CognaBright is used by families and organisations in multiple countries. Your information may be processed in Australia or in other locations where our service providers operate, under safeguards appropriate to that processing.
privacy.notice.heading111: Children and the people you support
privacy.notice.p118: CognaBright is intended to be set up and managed by an adult — a parent, guardian, or an authorised support professional — on behalf of the person they support. We do not knowingly collect information directly from a child.
privacy.notice.p119: You may ask for access, correction or deletion of your personal information, subject to identity verification and any applicable legal requirements. You can decline optional updates and still use CognaBright or submit a contact enquiry.
privacy.notice.p120: We may update this notice from time to time. We'll update the date at the top of this page when we do.
privacy.notice.p122: and choose "General question," or reach out through your account if you're already a CognaBright family or organisation customer.

accessibility.meta.description: Accessibility approach and known review needs for the CognaBright public marketing website.
accessibility.meta.title: Accessibility | CognaBright
accessibility.hero.title: Access is part of the work.
accessibility.hero.intro: The public website is designed to support keyboard navigation, readable resizing, clear structure, visible focus, reduced motion preferences and descriptive form guidance.
accessibility.measures.item1: A skip link and semantic page landmarks.
accessibility.measures.item12: Keyboard-operable navigation and form controls with targets of at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels for primary standalone controls.
accessibility.measures.item13: Two-colour visible focus indicators, including a high-contrast mode fallback.
accessibility.measures.item14: Normal text colours tested at 7:1 or better across the website’s primary light backgrounds.
accessibility.measures.item15: Responsive layouts with a readable 70-character text measure, increased paragraph spacing and no fixed body-text sizing.
accessibility.measures.item16: Labels, visible required-field instructions, help text, status announcements and browser-native validation for the enquiry form.
accessibility.measures.item17: Reduced animation when the device requests reduced motion.
accessibility.measures.item18: Meaningful page titles, section headings, link text and language metadata for each translated language name.
accessibility.measures.p1: The implementation targets Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA (the intermediate conformance level) and includes automated regression checks for the measures above and selected WCAG 2.2 Level AAA (the highest conformance level) criteria. This website does not claim full WCAG 2.2 Level AAA conformance, formal accessibility certification or a completed independent conformance audit.
accessibility.measures.p12: Before production publication, representative users and accessibility specialists should review keyboard order, zoom and reflow, screen-reader announcements, colour contrast in real deployment, error recovery and content comprehension. Hosting responses should also be checked for correct language, caching and error-page behaviour.
accessibility.measures.p13: If something prevents you from using this website, use the
accessibility.measures.p14: and describe the page, task, device or assistive technology involved. Do not include personal health information.
accessibility.footer.p1: Accessibility improvements should be informed by user experience and specialist review.
accessibility.footer.legal: CognaBright. Accessibility certification is not claimed.

delete-account.meta.description: Learn how to delete your CognaBright account or request account deletion if you can no longer access the app.
delete-account.meta.title: Delete your CognaBright account | CognaBright
delete-account.hero.title: Delete your CognaBright account
delete-account.hero.intro: You can ask CognaBright to delete your account and the data associated with it using the form on this page. You don't need to be signed in, and you don't need the app installed.
delete-account.hero.note: This page applies to CognaBright accounts for families, support people and organisation staff, and to the data linked to those accounts.
delete-account.inApp.heading1: Deleting data inside the CognaBright app
delete-account.inApp.p1: Deleting a whole CognaBright account is done by request, using the form on this page. Inside the app, a parent or account holder can also permanently delete all data for an individual child at any time:
delete-account.inApp.item12: Open Profile and choose the child.
delete-account.inApp.item13: In Privacy and deletion, select Delete all data for that child.
delete-account.inApp.item14: Review the information shown, then confirm.
delete-account.inApp.p12: This removes that child's data only. Your Parent account, Family workspace and subscription stay available. To delete your whole account, use the request form on this page.
delete-account.request.p1: Use this form if you can't access the app, have uninstalled it, or want your whole account deleted. Enter the email address you use to sign in to CognaBright.
delete-account.form.deletion_email.label: Account email address
delete-account.request.p13: The email address linked to your CognaBright account.
delete-account.form.deletion_name.label: Your name
delete-account.request.p14: Optional. Please don't include your password, security codes, or any information about a child.
delete-account.request.p15: We use these details only to handle your request. We may contact you at this email address to confirm that the request came from the account holder before anything is deleted.
delete-account.request.p16: Send your request from the email address linked to your CognaBright account, with the subject "Account deletion request", to:
delete-account.deleted.heading1: What happens when your account is deleted
delete-account.deleted.p1: When we process a deletion request from a family account holder, CognaBright permanently deletes:
delete-account.deleted.item1: each child profile in your Family workspace, together with everything recorded for that child, including routines, goals and micro-goals, progress records, logs and evidence, messages, reports, rewards, uploaded files and organisation connections;
delete-account.deleted.item12: your Family workspace, including its conversations, Session Companion profiles and Care-team connections.
delete-account.deleted.p12: Your sign-in is also permanently disabled, so the account can no longer be used. Deletion cannot be undone, so keep a copy of anything you need before you ask us to delete your account.
delete-account.deleted.p13: If you were invited into someone else's Family workspace, deleting your account ends your own access. It does not delete that Family workspace or its children's data, which stay under the control of the family's account holder.
delete-account.subscriptions.p1: Deleting your CognaBright account does not automatically cancel a paid subscription. To avoid further charges, cancel your subscription with the platform you subscribed through before you request deletion:
delete-account.subscriptions.item1: App Store: manage subscriptions in your Apple account settings on your iPhone or iPad.
delete-account.subscriptions.item12: Google Play: manage subscriptions in the Google Play Store app, under Payments and subscriptions.
delete-account.subscriptions.item13: CognaBright website: cancel through the billing platform you subscribed with, or contact us and we'll help.
delete-account.subscriptions.p12: Refunds are handled according to the policies of the platform you subscribed through, as described in our subscription terms.
delete-account.retained.heading1: Information we may need to keep
delete-account.retained.p1: After your account is deleted, we may keep a limited amount of information where we need it, such as:
delete-account.retained.item1: a minimal record of your sign-in identity, such as your email address, kept with sign-in permanently disabled so that security and audit records remain accurate;
delete-account.retained.item12: administrative records showing that the deletion took place;
delete-account.retained.item13: records of purchases and subscription transactions needed for financial, accounting and tax obligations;
delete-account.retained.item14: information needed to meet legal obligations, resolve disputes, prevent fraud or abuse, or keep CognaBright secure.
delete-account.retained.p12: We keep this information only for as long as reasonably necessary for these purposes, as described in our privacy notice. Payment platforms such as Apple and Google keep their own purchase records under their own policies.
delete-account.organisations.p1: If you use CognaBright as a member of an organisation, you can use this form to request deletion of your own account. Client and workspace records managed by your organisation are controlled by that organisation, and families control their own data.
delete-account.organisations.p12: A request from an organisation staff member cannot delete a family's workspace or another person's data. If you are an organisation administrator and want to close your organisation's account, please contact us.
delete-account.contact.p1: If you have questions about deleting your account or about your data, contact us. Our privacy notice and terms explain how CognaBright handles personal information.
